scenarios.prompt: A second local player joins mid-session on a new device while two players share one camera. Define stable player/device/session ownership.

criteria.identity: coop_session_id/revision plus player_id/device_id bindings are explicit.
criteria.lifecycle: Join/leave/rebind requests are idempotent and reconnect policy preserves identity.
criteria.ownership: Camera, input, inventory/progression and performance budgets remain separate owners.
